{{Top|leg}}
The '''Poss'Nomin government''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] government of the [[Poss'Nomin]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the planet [[Illarreen]]. It was established after the first contact between the Poss'Nomin and offworlders, and, after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it attempted to restructure Illarreen's stagnating economy.<ref name="Journal14">{{JournalCite|14|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref>
